entry.title: Accessibility
entry.summary: The pagination is a labelled navigation landmark that works with a keyboard and a screen reader.
entry.content:
The pagination is a navigation landmark named “Pagination”. Each page number is a link with a label such as “Page 2”. The current page is plain text marked as the current page, so it is announced but never links to itself. Previous and Next are links while there is somewhere to go, and plain text at either end.

Every link is at least 24 by 24 pixels and shows the focus ring when it has keyboard focus. The listing needs no script.
